content: Hi there, how can I assist with your freelance invoicing or payment confirmations today?
Hey, I just received a Stripe notification for an invoice settlement from last week, but I want to make sure everything lines up before I mark it complete.

Of course, let's double-check the details. I see your invoice #2024-1186 for $1,200 USD was paid via Stripe from client email robert.chang@eurotech.me on June 5th, and the transaction ID is ch_1NXYuQD8Rz3fT0E6JmR2. Does that match what you have?
Yes, that matches. The payment reached my business account ending in 8942 this morning. I just want to make sure the tax ID I used was correct.
Understood. For invoice #2024-1186, the associated tax ID is 83-2659047, linked to your registered entity, Samira Design LLC. That's the same info Stripe processed for this payment.
Great. And did Stripe note any discrepancies with my registered address? It should be 4200 Lakeview Blvd., Suite 301, Dallas, TX 75244.
Your Dallas address, 4200 Lakeview Blvd., Suite 301, 75244, appears correctly on the payment record and matches the bank details provided for the transfer. No discrepancies noted on their end.
Thanks for confirming. One last thing: I saw a reference code STRP-881293 on the payout. Is that standard?

Yes, STRP-881293 is Stripe's unique reference for this payout batch, which was processed at 08:12 AM CST today, no further action required. If you need to verify with your bank, they'll recognize that code.
Perfect. I'll file this as settled. Thanks for the quick help!
Happy to help, Samira! If you have any other urgent payment queries before your next invoice cycle, just let me know.
